purpose: Controlled internal production verification of a lesson arrival after analytics consent.

browserObservation.method: Native Chrome Incognito through CUA. The release agent reported these UI observations.
browserObservation.navigation: Full-page address navigation from the introduction to Tensor Shapes before accepting analytics.
browserObservation.beforeConsent: The Tensor Shapes lesson and a fresh consent banner were visible.
browserObservation.afterConsent: The banner disappeared and the browser remained on the Tensor Shapes URL.

schemaVerification.sourceSequence: AnalyticsProvider captures consent_granted and the current pageview after initialization. The consent-ready context then allows LessonSteps to observe the current lesson visit.

query.query:
SELECT
    properties.lessonId AS lesson_id,
    properties.tc_internal AS internal,
    min(timestamp) AS first_arrival_at,
    max(timestamp) AS last_arrival_at,
    count() AS arrivals,
    uniq($session_id) AS sdk_sessions,
    countIf($session_id IS NULL OR $session_id = '') AS missing_session_ids
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-11 12:49:50')
    AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-11 12:57:25')
    AND event = 'lesson_started'
    AND properties.tc_internal = true
GROUP BY lesson_id, internal
ORDER BY first_arrival_at
LIMIT 20

SELECT
    event,
    properties.tc_internal AS internal,
    properties.lessonId AS lesson_id,
    count() AS events,
    min(timestamp) AS first_event_at,
    max(timestamp) AS last_event_at,
    uniq($session_id) AS sdk_sessions,
    countIf($session_id IS NULL OR $session_id = '') AS missing_session_ids
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-11 12:49:50')
    AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-11 12:57:25')
    AND event IN ('$pageview', 'consent_granted', 'lesson_started')
GROUP BY event, internal, lesson_id
ORDER BY first_event_at
LIMIT 30

SELECT
    uniq($session_id) AS sdk_sessions,
    countIf($session_id IS NULL OR $session_id = '') AS missing_session_ids,
    countIf(event = '$pageview') AS pageviews,
    countIf(event = 'consent_granted') AS consent_events,
    countIf(event = 'lesson_started') AS lesson_arrivals,
    countIf(timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-11 12:55:25')) AS events_before_consent_second,
    min(timestamp) AS first_event_at,
    max(timestamp) AS last_event_at
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-11 12:49:50')
    AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-11 12:57:25')
    AND properties.tc_internal = true
    AND event IN ('$pageview', 'consent_granted', 'lesson_started')

sameSession.timestampComparison: The pre-consent count rounds the acceptance second down to 12:55:25 UTC. All three returned event timestamps are also later than the exact UI acceptance time of 12:55:25.574 UTC.

ingestionChecks.result: The first internal lesson-arrival query returned no rows. This read occurred about 31 seconds after consent and was treated as pending ingestion.
The companion query returned the Tensor Shapes arrival. Consent and pageview rows had not appeared yet.
The final arrival and companion reads returned one Tensor Shapes arrival, one consent event and one pageview.
A separate aggregate confirmed that all three internal events share one SDK session.

limitations: This verifies one controlled anonymous internal browser visit after the production release.
The browser sequence used full-page navigation. It does not prove the same-mounted SPA navigation regression. Focused unit tests cover that behavior.

The bounded event results establish late-consent delivery. They do not establish preconsent network silence, consent withdrawal or reacceptance, signed-in account persistence, server payment events or customer acquisition.
The returned companion events are all internal. No project test-account exclusion was applied to the companion query.
The evidence contains no raw person, user, distinct, session or transaction identifiers.
